name: Data Science & Machine Learning
description: Learn Data Science and Machine Learning in Jaipur with Python, statistics, data preparation, visualisation, predictive modelling, clustering and model evaluation at Groot Academy.
intro: Move from raw data to explainable analysis and evaluated machine-learning models. This path combines Python, statistics, visualisation and predictive methods, making it distinct from Data Analytics, which focuses more heavily on reporting, dashboards and business analysis.
audience: Students, graduates and professionals interested in data work. Basic Python and school-level mathematics are useful; review these foundations before the modelling modules.
modules: Python and data preparation
Use Python to work with datasets, identify missing values and prepare usable inputs for analysis.
Statistics and probability
Explore distributions, descriptive statistics, probability and the interpretation of relationships in data.
Exploratory analysis
Use visualisations to investigate patterns, communicate findings and identify data-quality issues.
Supervised learning
Study regression and decision trees and learn how predictions relate to input features.
Unsupervised learning and forecasting
Explore K-means clustering, market basket analysis and introductory time-series concepts.
Evaluation and applications
Compare model results, identify limitations and explore how machine learning and neural networks are applied to real problems.
projects: Exploratory data report
Clean a dataset, produce visualisations and explain the findings and limitations.
Prediction or clustering study
Build a small model and document its inputs, evaluation method and results.
faq: How is Data Science different from Data Analytics?

Data Analytics focuses mainly on querying, reporting, dashboards and communicating business findings. Data Science adds deeper statistical modelling and machine-learning methods for prediction and pattern discovery.
Is this also the preferred page for broad AI and Machine Learning course searches?

For now, broad predictive-AI and Machine Learning intent is consolidated here to avoid creating an overlapping AI page. Generative AI, prompt engineering and LLM application intent belongs on the dedicated Generative AI course page.

name: Data Analytics with Python & Power BI
description: Learn Data Analytics in Jaipur with Excel, SQL, Python, statistics, Tableau, Power BI and DAX for practical business reporting and dashboard projects at Groot Academy.
intro: Turn business questions into clear analysis, reports and dashboards. Work through data cleaning, Excel, SQL, Python, statistics and business-intelligence tools, while keeping this page focused on analyst and reporting workflows rather than machine-learning model development.
audience: Students, graduates and working professionals interested in analytical work. Basic computer and spreadsheet familiarity helps; programming topics start with Python foundations.
modules: Statistics for analysis
Explore descriptive statistics, distributions, correlation, sampling and hypothesis-testing concepts.
Excel and data cleaning
Use formulas, validation, pivot tables and charts to prepare and explore tabular data.
SQL
Query and combine relational data to answer analytical questions.
Python foundations
Practise Python basics and apply programmatic workflows to data preparation and analysis.
Visual analytics
Choose charts, filters and calculations for useful Tableau and Power BI reports.
Power BI reporting
Work with table relationships, DAX, dashboards and publishing workflows.
projects: Business analysis workbook
Clean a dataset, create a pivot-based summary and explain the business findings.
Interactive reporting dashboard
Build a dashboard with clear measures and filters, and present the decisions it supports.
faq: How is Data Analytics different from Data Science?
Data Analytics focuses on cleaning, querying, reporting, dashboards and communicating findings. Data Science goes further into predictive modelling and machine-learning techniques.
Does this Data Analytics course include Power BI?
Yes. The learning path includes Power BI relationships, DAX, reports and dashboards. Learners who want a narrower business-intelligence focus can also review the dedicated Power BI course page.

name: Power BI & Business Intelligence
description: Explore Power BI training in Jaipur with data relationships, DAX, visualisations, reports, dashboards and publishing at Groot Academy.
intro: Build reports that make business data easier to understand. Focus on the Power BI modules from the analytics learning path: relationships, calculations, visualisations, dashboards and publishing.
audience: Spreadsheet users, students and professionals who want to create business reports. Familiarity with rows, columns and basic formulas is helpful.
modules: Power BI foundations
Understand the reporting workflow and the role of Power BI components.
Data and relationships
Organise related tables and understand how relationships affect report results.
DAX calculations
Introduce DAX functions and calculations used to produce meaningful business measures.
Visualisations and reports
Choose suitable visuals, configure report pages and use filtering to support exploration.
Dashboards and tiles
Organise key information into a dashboard and distinguish it from a report.
Publishing and workspaces
Explore report publishing and workspace workflows, including how to review outputs before sharing.
projects: Business performance report
Create a report with clearly defined measures and drill into the drivers of a result.
Dashboard presentation
Summarise the key findings for a business audience and explain the data assumptions.
faq: Do I need Python for Power BI?
Python is not needed to begin the Power BI reporting modules. Spreadsheet familiarity and an understanding of data relationships are more directly useful at the start.

name: Generative AI & AI Tools
description: Learn Generative AI in Jaipur with prompt engineering, LLM concepts, Python, APIs, retrieval workflows, AI assistants and output evaluation at Groot Academy.
intro: Learn how to use and build with Generative AI: define tasks, design prompts, work with language-model APIs and evaluate outputs. This page targets LLM, prompt-engineering and AI-application intent, while predictive modelling and traditional Machine Learning stay on the Data Science and Machine Learning page.
audience: Beginners can start with AI tools and prompting. Learners who want to build applications should add Python and API foundations.
modules: AI and language model foundations
Distinguish using an AI tool from building an application connected to a model.
Prompt design
Describe goals, context, audience, output format and constraints, then improve results through iteration.
Python and API foundations
Work with files and data and understand how applications send requests and receive model responses.
Application concepts
Explore structured outputs, tool calling, embeddings and retrieval-based workflows.
AI-assisted workflows
Design a chatbot, content assistant or document question-answering prototype around a clear task.
Evaluation and responsible use
Test relevance and accuracy, protect sensitive data and identify situations requiring human review.
projects: Information chatbot
Create a small assistant that answers a defined set of questions and test its limitations.
Document assistant prototype
Connect a document workflow to AI and evaluate answers against the source material.
faq: Is coding required to start Generative AI?
You can begin with AI tools and prompt engineering without coding. Python and API skills become important when you want to build custom assistants, integrations or automation.
How is Generative AI different from Data Science and Machine Learning?

Generative AI focuses on language models, prompting, APIs and applications that generate or transform content. Data Science and Machine Learning focus more on data analysis, predictive models, clustering and model evaluation.

name: Cloud Computing & AWS
description: Learn cloud computing and AWS foundations in Jaipur: Linux, EC2, S3, networking, security, deployment and monitoring with Groot Academy.
intro: Understand how applications and data are hosted in the cloud. Build practical foundations in cloud service models, Linux, AWS compute and storage, networking and monitoring.
audience: Students and beginners interested in cloud infrastructure. Basic computer skills are a starting point; Linux and networking foundations are part of the path.
modules: Cloud service models
Understand cloud fundamentals and the roles of infrastructure, platform and software as a service.
Linux foundations
Practise the operating-system skills needed to work with servers.
AWS compute and storage
Explore EC2 instances and S3 storage through small hosting and storage tasks.
Networking and security
Understand how cloud resources communicate and review access and security fundamentals.
Application deployment
Follow a basic workflow for hosting a website or deploying a web application.
Monitoring
Observe server and application behaviour and document a cloud project.
projects: Website hosting project
Host a static website and explain the storage and access choices.
Application deployment lab
Deploy a small web application and demonstrate basic monitoring.
faq: Is this an AWS certification guarantee?
This page describes a practical cloud and AWS learning path. Ask the team about any certification-specific preparation offered in the current batch; it does not promise an exam result.

name: Cyber Security
description: Explore cyber security training in Jaipur with networking, Linux, web security, OWASP concepts, vulnerability assessment and reporting in authorised labs.
intro: Learn to recognise security weaknesses and communicate how to address them. Build networking and Linux foundations, then practise web security concepts, assessment and reporting in authorised lab environments.
audience: Students and beginners interested in defensive security. Networking and Linux fundamentals provide the foundation for later security exercises.
modules: Cyber security foundations
Understand common security risks and the importance of permission and scope in security work.
Networking fundamentals
Explore how devices communicate and investigate network behaviour in a lab.
Linux for security
Practise Linux skills used to inspect and manage a controlled security environment.
Web security
Study web security basics and OWASP concepts using deliberately configured exercises.
Vulnerability assessment
Review an authorised lab application and organise findings by their practical impact.
Security reporting
Document evidence, remediation recommendations and a capstone security checklist.
projects: Network analysis lab
Examine traffic in a controlled environment and explain the observations.
Web security report
Produce an assessment report for an authorised practice application, including remediation advice.
faq: Where will security exercises take place?
Practise only in authorised labs and systems for which permission has been granted. The learning path focuses on understanding weaknesses, reporting them and improving defences.

name: Flutter App Development
description: Learn Flutter app development in Jaipur with Dart, widgets, navigation, Firebase, location features, testing and publishing at Groot Academy.
intro: Build mobile interfaces with Flutter and connect them to useful application features. Begin with Dart, then progress through widgets, navigation, Firebase, location-aware features and app testing.
audience: Students and aspiring mobile developers. Begin with Dart syntax and programming concepts before moving into Flutter application development.
modules: Dart foundations
Learn Dart syntax, functions and object-oriented programming.
Flutter foundations
Understand the Flutter application structure and work with fundamental widgets.
Navigation and interaction
Connect screens with navigation and routing and add interactive behaviour.
Rich interfaces
Use visual, behavioural and motion-rich widgets to improve the app experience.
Connected and location-aware features
Explore Firebase integration and location-aware applications using GPS and maps.
Testing and publishing
Test app behaviour and review the steps involved in preparing an application for publishing.
projects: Multi-screen mobile app
Build a Flutter application with clear navigation and reusable widgets.
Connected application prototype
Add a Firebase-backed feature or location-aware screen, then document and test the workflow.
faq: Will I learn Dart as well as Flutter?
Yes. The learning path starts with Dart syntax, functions and object-oriented programming before progressing to Flutter widgets and application features.

name: Digital Marketing
description: Explore digital marketing training in Jaipur with SEO, social media, paid search, content, email marketing and campaign measurement at Groot Academy.
intro: Learn to connect a marketing goal with the right audience, channel and measurement plan. Explore search, social, content and email, and practise turning campaign results into useful decisions.
audience: Students, professionals, freelancers and business owners interested in marketing. Prior coding experience is not required; curiosity and regular practice are useful.
modules: Digital strategy
Understand customer behaviour, campaign goals and how to measure and improve marketing performance.
Search engine optimisation
Explore how content and website improvements support search visibility.
Search and paid campaigns
Study SEM and PPC concepts, ad planning and the role of Google Ads.
Social and content marketing
Plan content for social platforms, blogs and video around audience needs.
Email and inbound marketing
Explore email campaigns, audience relationships and content-led enquiry generation.
Measurement and optimisation
Use analytics concepts to interpret website and campaign results and recommend improvements.
projects: Marketing campaign plan
Create an audience-focused plan with channel choices, content ideas and measurable objectives.
SEO and performance review
Review a sample website and report opportunities, measurements and recommended next steps.
faq: Can someone without a technical background join?
Yes. The legacy course is intended for learners from different backgrounds and does not require prior coding experience.
